The Spire has let itself go. Welcome to Gravity!

- Encounters tumble into a pile. Choose them in any order, with no paths to follow.
- Visit 15 encounters to unlock the boss, then fight it or keep exploring.
- Make the pile your own with configurable encounter requirements, optional limits, highlight colors, and pulse strength.

────────────────────

高塔躺平了。欢迎来到 Gravity！

- 遭遇落成一堆，想先去哪个就去哪个，不必再沿着路线走。
- 完成15次遭遇即可解锁首领，随后可以挑战首领，也可以继续探索。
- 自由调整遭遇数量要求、可选的遭遇上限、高亮颜色和脉动强度，玩出自己的风格。
